ops.title: v0.22: precutBoundary advance — design pass before implementation
ops.description: The design-heavy v0.22 unit — an open design point, not a constant bump. Advancing the boundary makes the v0.20 era unprovable and its rows dead weight; BUILD-ORDER.md:148-150 supports keeping the harness narrowed to protocol-bump coverage. Recommendation on record: advance at v0.22.0, accepting dormant protocol-gate rows re-declared as the design pass decides. Also carries cffb17a's ExitTimeOut-vs-Shutdown design rider if the wave picks it up. GATE: soak plus the bbolt and archiver deletions landing first.

ops.text: A fable design pass settles the open point: with both eras at protocol 2 the protocol-gate/frame-identity rows have no mismatch to prove — decide whether they re-declare absent/entailed or the harness keeps dormant coverage until a protocol 3
